Risk scenario: Power or cooling loss interrupts service
Recommended treatment: Validate redundant power and recovery priorities

Risk scenario: Backups unavailable or cannot be restored
Recommended treatment: Maintain protected backups and test restoration

Risk scenario: Connectivity loss interrupts monitoring and escalation
Recommended treatment: Test alternate communications and escalation paths

Risk scenario: Emergency changes or weak access controls increase cyber risk
Recommended treatment: Enforce MFA least privilege logging and emergency-change review
Review supplier dependencies and test failover
